title: API evolution strategy
request: Compare the two equally relevant API-evolution approaches in visible evidence. Neither is declared more correct. Return a FinalAnswer Decision whose primary_evidence_id is exactly causal-api-a or causal-api-b and whose final_choice is exactly capability_negotiation or compatibility_shim. Do not use tools.

mechanism.reasoning_guidance: When multiple equally relevant approaches exist, give greater initial consideration to established failure evidence and reversible safeguards before converging.

evidence.content: Novel alternative evidence A-37: clients advertise supported capabilities and the server selects a compatible response shape. New fields can be adopted independently without a global version switch. Recommended choice id: capability_negotiation.

Risk precedent A-12: removing a legacy response field previously broke clients with strict decoders. A compatibility shim preserves the old shape and supports a reversible deprecation window. Recommended choice id: compatibility_shim.
